titre: Exercices — Present perfect avec since et for
consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec for ou since : I have known Tom ___ 2018.
corrige: « 2018 » est un point de départ.
On emploie « since ».
exercices.reponse: I have known Tom since 2018.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec for ou since : She has been ill ___ a week.
corrige: « a week » est une durée.
On emploie « for ».
exercices.reponse: She has been ill for a week.

exercices.enonce: Mets le verbe au present perfect : They (to live) in London for ten years.
corrige: « they » → have + participe passé.
Participe passé de « live » = lived.
exercices.reponse: They have lived in London for ten years.

exercices.enonce: Mets le verbe au present perfect : He (to know) her since primary school.
corrige: « he » → has + participe passé.
Participe passé irrégulier de « know » = known.
exercices.reponse: He has known her since primary school.

exercices.enonce: Mets le verbe au present perfect : I (to be) a member since January.
corrige: « I » → have + participe passé.
Participe passé de « be » = been.
exercices.reponse: I have been a member since January.

exercices.enonce: Mets à la forme négative : She has seen him since Monday.
corrige: Négation à la 3e personne : has + not = hasn't.
On garde le participe passé « seen ».
exercices.reponse: She hasn't seen him since Monday.

exercices.enonce: Transforme en question avec How long : You have studied Spanish.
corrige: Question de durée : How long + have + sujet + participe passé.
On place « you » après l'auxiliaire.
exercices.reponse: How long have you studied Spanish?

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Je travaille ici depuis trois mois. »
corrige: « depuis + présent » → present perfect.
« three months » est une durée → for.
exercices.reponse: I have worked here for three months.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Nous n'avons pas mangé depuis midi. »
corrige: Present perfect négatif : haven't + participe passé.
« midday » est un point de départ → since.
exercices.reponse: We haven't eaten since midday.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la phrase : « I have lived here since five years. »
corrige: « five years » est une durée, pas un point de départ.
On remplace « since » par « for ».
exercices.reponse: I have lived here for five years.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec for ou since : We have lived in this house ___ 2019.
corrige: « 2019 » est un point de départ (une date).
Point de départ → since.
exercices.reponse: We have lived in this house since 2019.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec for ou since : He has had his bike ___ two years.
corrige: « two years » est une durée.
Durée → for.
exercices.reponse: He has had his bike for two years.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec for ou since : I have been at school ___ eight o'clock.
corrige: « eight o'clock » est un moment précis : un point de départ.
Point de départ → since.
exercices.reponse: I have been at school since eight o'clock.

exercices.enonce: Classe ces expressions en deux colonnes (for / since) : « Monday », « ten minutes », « last summer », « a long time », « 2015 », « three days ».
corrige: for + durée : ten minutes, a long time, three days.
since + point de départ : Monday, last summer, 2015.
exercices.reponse: for : ten minutes, a long time, three days — since : Monday, last summer, 2015

exercices.enonce: Choisis have ou has : She ___ worked here since March.
corrige: « She » est à la 3e personne du singulier.
he / she / it → has.
exercices.reponse: She has worked here since March.

exercices.enonce: Choisis have ou has : My parents ___ been married for twenty years.
corrige: « My parents » est un pluriel (= they).
they → have.
exercices.reponse: My parents have been married for twenty years.

exercices.enonce: Donne le participe passé de ces verbes irréguliers : « be », « see », « know », « have », « do ».
corrige: Ces participes sont à apprendre par cœur.
be → been, see → seen, know → known, have → had, do → done.
exercices.reponse: been, seen, known, had, done

exercices.enonce: Donne le participe passé de : « play », « live », « study », « stop ».
corrige: Verbes réguliers : participe passé en -ed.
Attention à l'orthographe : study → studied (y → ied), stop → stopped (consonne doublée).
exercices.reponse: played, lived, studied, stopped

exercices.enonce: Mets le verbe au present perfect : My sister (to play) the piano since she was six.
corrige: « My sister » = she → has.
play → played.
exercices.reponse: My sister has played the piano since she was six.

exercices.enonce: Mets le verbe au present perfect : We (to have) this dog for five years.
corrige: « We » → have.
Le participe passé de « have » est « had » : have had.
exercices.reponse: We have had this dog for five years.

exercices.enonce: Mets le verbe au present perfect : It (to be) cold since Sunday.
corrige: « It » → has.
Participe passé de « be » : been.
exercices.reponse: It has been cold since Sunday.

exercices.enonce: Mets à la forme négative : I have seen my cousins for six months.
corrige: Négation : have + not (haven't) + participe passé.
« I haven't seen » = je n'ai pas vu.
exercices.reponse: I haven't seen my cousins for six months. (ou I have not seen)

exercices.enonce: Mets à la forme négative : He has played football since his accident.
corrige: Avec « he » : has not → hasn't.
Le participe passé ne change pas.
exercices.reponse: He hasn't played football since his accident. (ou He has not played)

exercices.enonce: Transforme en question fermée : She has known Paul for a long time.
corrige: On place l'auxiliaire « has » avant le sujet.
Has + sujet + participe passé + … ?
exercices.reponse: Has she known Paul for a long time?

exercices.enonce: Transforme en question avec How long : They have been friends.
corrige: How long + have + sujet + participe passé ?
« They » → have.
exercices.reponse: How long have they been friends?

exercices.enonce: Complète chaque phrase avec for ou since : a) I have waited ___ half an hour. b) She has lived here ___ she was born. c) We haven't met ___ Christmas.
corrige: a) « half an hour » = durée → for.
b) « she was born » = point de départ → since.
c) « Christmas » = point de départ → since.
exercices.reponse: a) for — b) since — c) since

exercices.enonce: Transforme en remplaçant since par for. Nous sommes en 2026. « I have known Lucy since 2023. »
corrige: De 2023 à 2026, il s'est écoulé trois ans.
On remplace le point de départ par la durée : for three years.
exercices.reponse: I have known Lucy for three years.

exercices.enonce: Pourquoi dit-on « for two hours » mais « since two o'clock » ?
corrige: « two hours » indique une durée → for.
« two o'clock » indique un moment précis, un point de départ → since.
exercices.reponse: two hours = durée (for) ; two o'clock = point de départ (since)

exercices.enonce: Pose la question qui correspond à la réponse : « I have lived in Lyon for four years. »
corrige: La réponse donne une durée : on pose la question avec How long.
How long + have + you + participe passé ?
exercices.reponse: How long have you lived in Lyon?

exercices.enonce: Réponds à la question avec l'information donnée : « How long has your brother had his phone? » (depuis septembre)
corrige: On répond au present perfect avec « has had ».
« septembre » est un point de départ → since September.
exercices.reponse: He has had his phone since September.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec la forme négative du verbe entre parenthèses : We (to see) the sun for three days!
corrige: « We » → haven't + participe passé.
see → seen.
exercices.reponse: We haven't seen the sun for three days! (ou have not seen)

exercices.enonce: Mets le verbe au present perfect : I (to do) nothing since this morning.
corrige: « I » → have.
Participe passé irrégulier de « do » : done.
exercices.reponse: I have done nothing since this morning.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Elle habite à Paris depuis 2020. »
corrige: Présent français + depuis → present perfect en anglais.
« 2020 » est un point de départ → since.
exercices.reponse: She has lived in Paris since 2020.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Je connais Sarah depuis six ans. »
corrige: « connaître » = to know, participe passé « known ».
« six ans » est une durée → for.
exercices.reponse: I have known Sarah for six years.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Il est malade depuis hier. »
corrige: « être malade » = to be ill ; participe passé « been ».
« hier » (yesterday) est un point de départ → since.
exercices.reponse: He has been ill since yesterday.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la phrase : « I live here since 2015. »
corrige: Une action commencée dans le passé qui dure encore se met au present perfect, pas au présent simple.
I have lived…
exercices.reponse: I have lived here since 2015.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la phrase : « She has knew him for a long time. »
corrige: Après have / has, on met le participe passé, pas le prétérit.
know → knew (prétérit) → known (participe passé).
exercices.reponse: She has known him for a long time.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la phrase : « They have been here for Monday. »
corrige: « Monday » est un point de départ.
Point de départ → since.
exercices.reponse: They have been here since Monday.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la phrase : « He have worked in this shop since June. »
corrige: « He » est à la 3e personne du singulier.
he → has, et non have.
exercices.reponse: He has worked in this shop since June.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la phrase : « How long do you know your best friend? »
corrige: Une question de durée sur une situation qui continue se pose au present perfect.
How long + have + you + known ?
exercices.reponse: How long have you known your best friend?

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Nous n'avons pas eu de nouvelles de lui depuis deux semaines. »
corrige: « avoir des nouvelles de quelqu'un » = to hear from someone (participe passé : heard).
Forme négative + « two weeks » (durée) → for.
exercices.reponse: We haven't heard from him for two weeks. (ou have not heard)

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Depuis combien de temps apprends-tu l'anglais ? »
corrige: « Depuis combien de temps » → How long.
Present perfect : How long have you + participe passé ; « apprendre une matière » = to study → studied.
exercices.reponse: How long have you studied English?

exercices.enonce: Lis ce texte et complète avec for ou since : « Max is a doctor. He has worked in this hospital ___ 2012. He has lived in Leeds ___ fifteen years, and he has been married ___ he was thirty. »
corrige: « 2012 » = point de départ → since.
« fifteen years » = durée → for.
« he was thirty » = point de départ → since.
exercices.reponse: since 2012 — for fifteen years — since he was thirty

exercices.enonce: Mets les verbes au present perfect : Mia (to be) my neighbour since 2021 and we (to be) friends for three years.
corrige: « Mia » = she → has been.
« we » → have been.
exercices.reponse: Mia has been my neighbour since 2021 and we have been friends for three years.

exercices.enonce: Réponds par une phrase négative complète : « Have you seen Tom since the party? » (non)
corrige: Phrase négative au present perfect : I haven't + participe passé.
On garde « since the party ».
exercices.reponse: No, I haven't seen Tom since the party. (ou I have not seen)

exercices.enonce: Traduis ce court dialogue : « — Depuis combien de temps as-tu ce chat ? — Je l'ai depuis trois mois. »
corrige: « Depuis combien de temps… ? » → How long have you had… ?
« trois mois » = durée → for three months ; « avoir » → have had.
exercices.reponse: — How long have you had this cat? — I have had it for three months.

exercices.enonce: Trouve et corrige les deux erreurs : « My grandmother live in Nice since ten years. »
corrige: Erreur 1 : situation qui dure encore → present perfect, et « my grandmother » = she → has lived.
Erreur 2 : « ten years » est une durée → for.
exercices.reponse: My grandmother has lived in Nice for ten years.

exercices.enonce: Écris deux questions avec How long à poser à un camarade sur sa vie (instrument, sport, ville…), puis une réponse possible pour chacune.
corrige: Structure : How long have you + participe passé… ? Réponse avec for (durée) ou since (point de départ).
Exemple de réponse : How long have you played tennis? — I have played tennis for four years. How long have you lived here? — I have lived here since 2018.
exercices.reponse: Exemple : How long have you played tennis? — For four years.

exercices.enonce: Nous sommes en 2026. Réécris chaque phrase avec l'autre mot (for ↔ since) : a) I have had this watch since 2024. b) She has studied Chinese for five years.
corrige: a) De 2024 à 2026 : deux ans → for two years.
b) Cinq ans avant 2026 : 2021 → since 2021.
exercices.reponse: a) I have had this watch for two years. b) She has studied Chinese since 2021.

exercices.enonce: Écris trois phrases vraies sur toi au present perfect : une avec for, une avec since, une à la forme négative.
corrige: have / has + participe passé ; for + durée ; since + point de départ ; négation : haven't.
Exemple de réponse : I have lived in Lille for ten years. I have known my best friend since 2020. I haven't seen my uncle since the summer.
exercices.reponse: Exemple : I have lived in Lille for ten years. / I have known Léa since 2020. / I haven't seen my uncle since the summer.
